comments.author: Beatrice
comments.body: the real use of this skill has already been discussed here. But one more time: Your storage skill is pitted against player and npc plunder skill when you are defeated in sea AND land battles. It decreases how much is taken away from you. It also helps protect the durability of your inventory items while sailing. Very underrated skill IMO.

Storage does protect your inventory items, but it needs to be at a bit further up level - as in more then what's needed to protect trade goods - then your opponents plunder level.

Be warned that it does NOT protect inventory if a pirate uses a Pillage order Pillage Order on you (trade goods don't seem to be affected though). I have R14+2 storage, and for good measure miser chains yet I still had my figure head and pet plundered from me, when a pirate attacked and used one on me.

comments.author: Sylvia
comments.body: Any advice on leveling storage past R10?

comments.author: Junchul
comments.body:
I used Miser's chains to get mine up quickly once I hit R10 (you should be able to find them easily in comp shops). If you have a high fishing rank you can sit between those two rocks south of Syracuse and fish there. I caught plenty of marlin and mako shark there and used the recipe from Fisherman Arts and my storage rank went up in no time.

Another way to do it is nanban trade with China to get Bamboo and turn them into Bamboo Leafs with the Trainer guy in Lisbon. You probably wont get a lot of Bamboo though unless you have those Nanban Purveyor Certificates...

Storage directly counters Plunder, it doesn't make you unplunderable but it determines if you lose any "rare" items and to an extent how much gold and trade goods. comments.author: BonnyLass
comments.body: Since higher level recipe items yield more proficiency, mako and swordfish are one of the best ways to grind this skill. But don't underestimate tuna! Despite being a simple r8 recipe, they also give great amounts of proficiency, and are much easier to catch in bulk, or grow on private farms.

comments.author: Blake.C
comments.body: There is one recipe that's actually better then Mako and Swordfsh when grinding Storage. You need to have Hangzhou opened for nanban, or at least one port in China. Do a trade for Bamboo. Bring it to Lisbon to the Trainer NPC. There's a R14 storage recipe that uses 1 bamboo to make a ton of Bamboo Leaf. Storage skill goes up wild with that one, and you can make a nice profit selling the Bamboo Leafs as pet food. And it can be done as early as R5 Storage if you have the right equipment plus the miser chains.
